description.html: The Everywear Jogger fuses performance fiber with a clean, tailored silhouette that pairs as well with a crisp tee and high-tops as it does with your gym uniform. Four-way stretch and moisture-wicking keeps you cool in crowded rooms; a DWR finish fends off coffee spills and unexpected street mist. Finished with an elastic waistband and secure pockets, it’s the jogger that blurs the line between workout and weekend. And it nails both. Fabric: 90% Polyester/10% Spandex Machine Wash Cold, Tumble Dry Low
